newsitem.title: JAPAN: JGBs up but off highs as sentiment remains firm.
newsitem.headline: JGBs up but off highs as sentiment remains firm.

text.p: *JGBs clinging a bit below their day's highs after recovering from morning dip on short-covering, although topside heavy near 126.60 for now despite continuing strong sentiment.
*Although yield on cash bonds edged towards record low, lack of strong factors today inhibited further yield falls.
